item.title: Watch Niall Horan Surprise ‘Off Campus’ Star Ella Bright by Turning Her Cover Song Into a Duet
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music news! Today, we're talking about a exciting collaboration between Ella Bright and Niall Horan. You might know Ella from the hit Prime Video show 'Off Campus', where music plays a central role. Well, she just got a surprise of a lifetime from none other than Niall Horan himself."
[Clip of Niall Horan's surprise message plays]
Host: "In a video posted by Island Records, Niall surprises Ella with a new version of her cover of 'Baby Now That I Found You', featuring his added vocals. And let me tell you, her reaction is priceless."
[Clip of Ella's reaction plays]
Host: "As you just heard, Ella is completely blown away by the surprise duet. And who can blame her? The song is beautiful, and it's clear she's a huge fan of Niall's work. In fact, she even compares it to his hit song 'This Town'."
[Clip of Ella's comparison plays]
Host: "The track is part of the 'Off Campus: The Mixtape (Extra Credit Edition)', which just dropped with six additional tracks, including new covers by Suki Waterhouse, The Beaches, and Carol Ades. And for Niall Horan, this collaboration comes on the heels of his new album 'Dinner Party', which debuted at number 7 on the Billboard 200."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Make sure to check out the new duet and the rest of the 'Off Campus' soundtrack. And if you want to stay up-to-date on the latest music news, subscribe to our podcast and follow us on social media. Thanks for listening!"
